Regional Scholars Program (separate 2026-27 rate sheet): non-residents from a high school within about 250 miles of MTSU or from Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina or Virginia, with ACT 25+ (or SAT equivalent) and 12+ hours, pay $7,836 tuition + $1,188 Program Services Fee = $9,024 per semester; students must apply to the Academic Common Market if available.
